commun:
FORMAT (identical for the three candidates of this series): vertical portrait image 1024 x 1536, TRANSPARENT background, no scenery, no text, no logo, no poster, no flag. Waist-up official portrait like the candidate cards shown on French TV on election night at 8 pm. The character faces the camera (very slight three-quarter at most), centered horizontally, top of the hair at about 6 % from the top of the image, chin at about 30 %, the image cut at the waist at the bottom edge. Calm, composed, dignified attitude: no raised fist, no shouting, no open mouth, arms close to the body so the silhouette stays compact and fits a narrow frame. Soft studio light from the front with a subtle warm rim light on the edges.
STYLE: exactly the art style of the attached game references (the big illustration "Choisissez votre candidat"): French satirical caricature videogame, hand painted rich textures, clean confident black ink contours, warm lively saturated colors, cinematic lighting, comic-book spirit, very high detail and polish. The face must remain recognisable as the same caricature character as in the references (same glasses, hair, clothes, proportions, same head size relative to the body).
